prompts.frames:
Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: canonical structural UI frame atlas for this exact hand-painted children's fantasy game.
Input image 1 is the approved Moje liška layout. Input image 2 is the approved Katakomby layout. They are STYLE AND SHAPE REFERENCES. Extract/reconstruct their empty controls faithfully, not a generic repeated plaque.
Produce ONE 1536x1024 atlas with SIX well separated components arranged in a strict 2-column by 3-row grid. Equal 768x341 cells. All parts completely inside the cell, centered, with 20px clear padding minimum. Perfectly FLAT #00ff00 background for deterministic key removal, no background gradients.
Top left: the exact long central TITLE FRAME from image 1, concave stepped gold ends, central blue faceted diamond crest, no words; about 700x185. 
Top right: a short compact stat LABEL FRAME like beneath the left fox, octagonal bevels with flat-ended chamfers, absolutely no side diamonds or spear tips, about 630x185; empty navy center.
Middle left: ONE canonical SKILL NAME RAIL from image 1, gently rounded left end that is meant to sit under a large ability icon, straight long smooth edges, tapered pointed right end with a small cyan inlay, about 700x155, empty dark-blue center, no built-in icons, circles, locks or numbers.
Middle right: ONE wide MODULE LIST CARD from image 2, substantial rectangular navy enamel field with chamfered gold corners and tiny cyan insets, about 700x205. Quiet broad inner safe area; no central title jewel and no pointed spear ends.
Bottom left: ONE prominent thumb ACTION FRAME from image 2, heavy golden bevel around a broad octagonal navy field, about 680x190, generous empty center for a separate door or apple icon and runtime text. No side diamonds or title crest.
Bottom right: ONE dark small UPGRADE INSET from image 1, a squat rounded-diamond / clipped octagonal shape with dark blue interior and thick aged BRONZE metal rim, about 240x180. Empty centered socket for a separate padlock. It must be a solid painted inset, NOT a thin circular outline.
Match the premium painterly finish, deep Prussian-blue satin enamel, dimensional honey-gold bevels and restrained turquoise. Frame geometry must be stable, complete, visibly thick, not flat vector art. These are reusable NORMAL surfaces, runtime code makes hover/pressed states. Do NOT duplicate one universal long plaque six times.
Children cannot rely on reading. Do not generate any text, letters, numerals, fake writing, foxes, characters, locks, swords, hearts or pictograms. All numbers, labels, larger comparison signs, layouts, hit areas, disabled state and animation are runtime layers. Keep every decorative corner intact.
prompts.abilities:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: painted ability icon STATE PAIR ATLAS for approved children's game UI.
Use the ability icons at the lower left of supplied image 1 as the exact visual model: hand-painted cut gemstones and warm thick gold edges. Make 6 isolated icons in a strict TWO-column THREE-row grid on a 1024x1536 image, each cell512x512. Left column normal, right column active. Shared silhouette, scale, pose, placement and identical generous margins in each state pair; ONLY lighting/glow changes. Each icon centered around cell center, roughly330x370, no part touches a boundary.
Row1: dimensional faceted CYAN BLUE SHIELD with thick beveled gold rim, point at bottom, angular crystal reflections. Not the smooth cartoon cyan shield.
Row2: faceted bright PINK HEART with thick gold bezel and exactly TWO green leaves spreading beneath it. Mature painted gemstone, no plastic candy.
Row3: a substantial AMBER GOLD LIGHTNING BOLT, clean unmistakable angular silhouette and bright beveled highlights, exactly one bolt. NO creature, face, purple orb, explosion or target below the bolt.
Normal states are rich and legible without glow. Active states add compact matching colored light just around the same silhouette. Keep warm amber reflections and cool blue shadows consistent with reference.
Perfect flat #00ff00 background. No shadow on the background, no environment, no UI frames, no circles, no labels, letters or numerals. Players cannot read; icons alone must be immediately distinct. All runtime text, hit areas and label rails are separate assets. Pair alignment is mandatory.
prompts.progress:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: hand-painted fantasy progress and lock icon STATE PAIR ATLAS.
Reference is the approved Moje liška screen. Match its tactile bronze and honey-gold icons exactly, not flat web icons.
Create a 1024x1536 atlas, strict two columns and three rows, equal 512x512 cells, on perfectly flat #00ff00 green. Every paired silhouette is identical, same scale, pose and placement, generous padding.
Row1: a SINGLE CLOSED PADLOCK, round arching shackle and broad squared body with softened corners, clearly drawn black keyhole, warm beveled metal. Left normal bronze-gold readable even when unlit, right same padlock illuminated bright honey gold. NO filigree, blue pattern, crest, jewels, circle or UI surround. The lock will sit in a separately generated squat octagonal inset. Keep body and shackle centered on the same x axis.
Row2: a large PAW-SHAPED INLAY, exactly four distinct rounded toe pads above one large central pad. Its OUTER BORDER follows the paw silhouette, never a circular coin. Thick dimensional honey-gold outline and broad tactile pads. Left state unfilled, dark warm bronze pads with visible painted highlights and GOLD edge; right state the same paw filled with bright amber gold, small warm radiance only. Identical geometry. This is a progress token, must stay conspicuous on a blue stone floor.
Row3: a pair of CROSSED SHORT GOLD SWORDS as one compact attack pictogram, simple clean broad golden blades and amber handles, silhouette of an X. Left warmly lit normal; right same swords with bright compact gold highlights. No steel-gray sword, no animal or frame.
Hand-painted facets, thick edges, selective highlight and blue reflected shadows; consistent scale and margins. No words, text, numerals, counters or backgrounds. Children cannot read; each shape must be recognisable at small size. The source is one canonical paired sheet; extraction uses a SHARED crop per pair and runtime layering for state transitions.
